blocks.text: DETROIT — The Detroit Pistons tipped off training camp without Jalen Duren on the roster. Pistons general manager Trajan Langdon said last May that the team wanted to sign the All-Star center to a contract extension, but the two sides had not reached an agreement ahead of media day on Monday afternoon. If Detroit and Duren don’t reach a deal, he has until Thursday to sign a one-year qualifying offer from the franchise.
